# Apartments TOJO – Grebaštica, Dalmatia, Croatia
# https://www.apartments-tojo.com/

## About

Apartments TOJO is a family-run holiday accommodation in Grebaštica, a peaceful seaside village 14 km south of Šibenik, Dalmatia, Croatia. The property offers three private apartments with sea views, private terraces, free Wi-Fi, and free parking. Guests receive a welcome basket with homemade olive oil, wine, figs, and seasonal produce.

**Owner:** Tonći Peran
**Address:** Bašelovići 12A, 22010 Grebaštica, Croatia
**Phone:** +385 95 550 2487
**Email:** tonci.peran@gmail.com
**WhatsApp:** https://wa.me/385955502487

## Apartments

- **Apartment A1** – 1st floor, 4 persons, ~50 m², private terrace with sea view
- **Apartment A2** – 1st floor, 5 persons, ~75 m², balcony, panoramic sunset views
- **Apartment A3** – 1st floor, 4 persons, ~45 m², all amenities included

All apartments include: air conditioning, fully equipped kitchen, sea view, private terrace or balcony, beach 200 m, free parking, free Wi-Fi, pets allowed.

**Check-in:** 14:00 | **Check-out:** 10:00
**Price range:** from €60/night (direct booking, no commission)

## Location

Grebaštica is a small Dalmatian coastal village on the Šibenik Riviera.

- 14 km from Šibenik city centre
- 25 km from Krka National Park (Skradinski Buk waterfall)
- 40 km from Kornati National Park
- 80 km from Split
- 130 km from Zadar
- Crystal-clear Adriatic sea, pebble beaches
- Medieval Bedem Oštrica fortress (built 1497)
